abstract: This paper explores the influence of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) factors on Chinese companies’ cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&A). It finds that acquirers prefer targets with equal or superior ESG ratings, reflecting a strategic emphasis on sustainability. While initial post-acquisition performance may face challenges, acquiring firms ultimately experience improvements in ESG performance, particularly through green innovation. This research highlights ESG’s growing importance in strategic decision-making, contributing to the literature on cross-border M&A and sustainability by offering insights into how ESG ratings shape acquisition outcomes and long-term corporate sustainability.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了环境、社会与治理（ESG）因素对中国企业跨境并购（M&A）的影响。研究发现，收购方倾向于选择ESG评级相当或更高的目标企业，这反映了对可持续性的战略重视。尽管并购初期业绩可能面临挑战，但收购企业最终在ESG表现上有所提升，尤其是通过绿色创新实现改善。本研究凸显了ESG在战略决策中日益增长的重要性，通过揭示ESG评级如何影响并购成果及企业长期可持续性，为跨境并购与可持续性领域的文献贡献了见解。

title: From profit to planet: ESG’s impact on Chinese companies’ cross-border M&A activity*
title_zh: 从利润到地球：ESG对中国企业跨境并购活动的影响

abstract: There is an increasing interest in applying variational Bayes techniques to estimating large Bayesian vector autoregressions (VARs) with stochastic volatility. However, less attention has been paid to the development of appropriate tools for comparing these high-dimensional models, especially among those designed to address COVID-19 outliers. This paper develops a marginal likelihood estimator that combines importance sampling and variational approximation for comparing large VARs with different time-varying volatility specifications and outlier adjustments. Through a Monte Carlo study, we show that the proposed approach is fast and able to identify the correct models. The effectiveness of the proposed method is further illustrated through an empirical application of comparing a variety of 180-variable VARs.
title: Bayesian model comparison for large Bayesian VARs after the COVID-19 pandemic
title_zh: COVID-19疫情后大型贝叶斯向量自回归模型的贝叶斯模型比较
